mechanism: Both are beta-lactam antibiotics with overlapping spectra; combined use increases risk of adverse effects and potential cross-reactivity in penicillin-allergic patients, though cephalosporins have lower cross-reactivity with piperacillin.
action: Avoid concurrent use unless clinically justified for synergistic effect; if both required, ensure patient has no documented penicillin allergy and monitor for allergic reactions and superinfection.
